cases.question: Who are the main players in the HBM memory boom right now? I want the actual companies riding the AI-memory wave, not the whole semi index.
cases.result_summary: Resolved to node 10010400 'HBM & AI Memory' (tier-3, not generic semis). Members: KR = Samsung(005930.KO), SK Hynix(000660.KO), SK Holdings; US = SK Hynix ADR, Micron(MU.US), Penguin Solutions; TW = AP Memory, Etron. Real HBM leaders + supply chain.
cases.reason: Correct HBM-specific theme; returns SK Hynix, Samsung, Micron + supply-chain names, pure company discovery.

cases.question: Show me cheap semiconductor names in Asia — low P/E chip makers in places like Taiwan, Korea and Japan.
cases.result_summary: Scoped GICS 4530 (Semis & Semi Equip) + country TW/KR/JP + pe 'low' percentile, sorted pe. 48 hits, all Asian chip names (KOSDAQ/TWO), pe surfaced in matched.financial.pe.value (e.g. Vessel 177350.KQ pe=0.39). No US/EU names.
cases.reason: Sector + Asia region + low-P/E valuation all applied; real Asian chip names, no US/EU leakage.

defects.desc: find_fspattern('below'/'low'/'cheapest') returns EMPTY candidates for valuation-shape queries; the 'low'/'below' pattern tokens are only discoverable from the screen_unified schema text, not the resolver. Client is forced to read the executor schema instead of the intended resolver.
Result rows do not carry a top-level 'pe' field; the screened value lives under matched.financial.pe.value while price context shows normalized_pe — easy for a client to think pe wasn't applied.

cases.question: How's the US yield curve looking — is the 2s10s still inverted, and where are short-term money-market rates sitting?
cases.result_summary: Full US curve: 3M 3.80%, 2Y 4.20%, 5Y 4.39%, 10Y 4.70%, 30Y 5.26%. 2s10s = +50.6bps NOT inverted (read 'mid-range'); 10Y3M +90.6bps near 52w highs. 3M yield covers short-term MM rate. Rates-domain, no equities.
cases.reason: Treasury yields across curve + correct 2s10s sign (dis-inverted) + short end; stays in rates domain.

defects.desc: User explicitly asked for money-market rates (SOFR/EFFR); bond_pulse('US yield curve') returns the govt-bond curve incl 3M bill as the short proxy but no dedicated .MM rate row. A separate bond_pulse('SOFR') would be needed — minor coverage/guidance nuance.

cases.question: หุ้นกลุ่ม defense ในยุโรปมีตัวไหนน่าสนใจบ้าง อยากได้ชื่อบริษัทอาวุธ/กาโลโหงยุโรป ไม่เอาของอเมริกา
cases.result_summary: Node 22000000 'Defense & Geopolitical Fragmentation'. Real EU primes surfaced: Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, Renk, thyssenkrupp/TKMS (DE); BAE, Babcock, QinetiQ, Chemring (GB); Thales, Safran, Airbus, Dassault, Exail (FR). Leonardo(0ONG.LSE) + Saab(0GWL.LSE) exist but only via find_stock.
cases.reason: Correct EU defense names returned, but the DE list mixes in US primes (Lockheed/Raytheon/Boeing/Palantir as XETRA cross-listings) violating the explicit 'no US'; IT & SE returned NONE so Leonardo/Saab missed by theme_players.

defects.desc: theme_players filters by TRADING-MARKET country, not domicile: country=DE returns US primes listed on XETRA (Lockheed/Raytheon/Boeing/Palantir), and country=IT/SE return NONE for domestic champions Leonardo/Saab (they are captured under their .LSE cross-listings, domicile IT/SE). A 'European defense, exclude US' request cannot be satisfied cleanly.
No domicile-based filter on theme_players; the country param semantics (venue vs operating country) are undocumented, forcing per-country probing and manual US exclusion.

cases.question: Gold has been ripping — how are the gold miners doing versus the metal itself? Give me a read on gold and the main mining names.
cases.result_summary: Gold (GOLD.COMM) last 4661.6, +38%/1y, uptrend above 50/200d. Miners (node 30060200 'Gold'): Newmont, Agnico Eagle, Barrick, Kinross, Wheaton, Franco-Nevada, Royal Gold, B2Gold. Metal vs equities cleanly distinguished.

cases.question: I'm hunting small-cap biotech in China — early-stage names, not the big pharma. What's out there?
cases.result_summary: screen_unified with only universe filters (gics+country+size, no fund/ta) ERRORED: 'need at least one of ta or fundamental conditions'. Fell back to screen_stocks(gics=352010,country=CN) -> real China biotech: BeiGene, RemeGen, InnoCare, Amoytop, Wantai, Hotgen, Pharmaron, BGI.
cases.reason: Correct sector+China and real biotech names, but the SIZE (small-cap) filter could not be enforced: screen_unified rejects a pure-universe screen, and the fallback screen_stocks has no size param so mega-cap BeiGene leaks in.

defects.desc: screen_unified requires >=1 ta/fundamental condition — a pure discovery screen (sector+country+size only) is impossible, so 'what small-cap biotech is out there' has no clean executor. Error is clear but the capability gap forces a fallback tool.

screen_stocks (the news-impact discovery tool) exposes gics+country but NO size / market-cap filter, so the small-cap constraint is silently dropped and mega-cap pharma (BeiGene) appears despite the explicit 'not the big pharma'.

cases.question: Compare copper as a play on electrification: give me the commodity backdrop and the biggest copper miners, then tell me which of those miners look cheapest on fundamentals.
cases.result_summary: Copper (COPPER.COMM) last 6.58, +48%/1y, near 52w highs, LME inventory drawdown. Miners (node 30020100): Freeport(FCX), Southern Copper(SCCO), BHP, Antofagasta(ANTO), Teck, Hudbay(HBM), Ero. Valuation via financials: cheapest pe = ERO 12, Hudbay 16, Teck 17; priciest ANTO 36, FCX 34, SCCO 28.
cases.reason: Commodity + real copper miners + valuation ranking all delivered, BUT only by composing 3 tools because screen_unified's theme filter is broken; the intended single screen (theme+pe) returned the whole market.

defects.desc: MAJOR: screen_unified theme=[30020100] does NOT scope to theme members — it returns the whole market (NVDA/AAPL/GOOG/... with a pe leg, or top-mcap names with a dummy leg). The theme filter is silently ignored, producing wrong-but-200 results. theme_players proves the copper cohort exists.

No way to rank a THEME cohort by valuation in one call: theme_players has no valuation sort, screen_unified theme filter is broken, and find_gics('copper mining') only resolves to sector '15' (Materials). Valuation-within-theme requires manually feeding cohort tickers to financials.

top_defects: screen_unified theme=[node_id] filter is BROKEN — silently returns the whole market instead of theme members (tm-10), a wrong-but-200 result; no single-call way to rank a theme cohort by valuation.

theme_players filters by trading-VENUE country, not domicile — US primes leak into country=DE defense (tm-04), and domestic champions (Leonardo IT, Saab SE, Novo DK, Cameco CA) return NONE for their home country and only appear under a cross-listing venue.

Discovery/size gaps: screen_unified rejects a pure universe screen (needs a ta/fund leg), and screen_stocks has no size filter — so 'small-cap China biotech' can't enforce small-cap and mega-cap BeiGene leaks in (tm-06); also find_fspattern returns empty for valuation shapes and find_stock batch mis-resolved USD/CNY to a bond yield (tm-08).
